TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. The transaction gets pricingRuleRequest and sends it to ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules for the creation flow. 2. The library validates the effective date range and raises ABKO10000404 when validatePost detects a non blank date validation result, including the case where endDate is before startDate. 3. The library checks duplicate pricing rule conflicts using details, fee and payment methods: it raises ABKO10010401 when an exact duplicate candidate has the same fee, ABKO10010402 when an exact variable duplicate candidate has a different fee, and ABKO10010415 when a variable duplicate candidate shares at least one payment method. 4. Before persistence, the library resolves each detail value and raises ABKO10010004 when a detail query is missing, when the resolved value is empty, or when the repository lookup throws NoResultException. 5. If a PricingRuleException is raised during those validations or resolutions, the library adds an advice with the propagated code and description, returns null, and the transaction sets severity EWR when advice exists. 6. When validations pass, the library gets the request user, generates audit and pricing rule ids, inserts the audit record, inserts the pricing rule and its details, assigns the generated id to the DTO, and returns it. 7. The transaction always assigns pricingRuleResponse from the library result and then applies severity based on the collected advices.
